model_output.verdict: A product designer with named projects, but too little detail about the design decisions and results.
write_up: Your resume points to product design work at Loop Fitness and Brightpath Studio, followed by your current barista role. It’s common to list projects this way, but the design work needs more detail to stand out in a pile: a recruiter can see what you worked on, not enough about the decisions you made or what changed.

The design system line is your best model. It names what you created, that it was the app’s first, and the tool you used. Your current work is accounted for, but your last listed design role ended in February 2024, so the Loop Fitness work needs to do more to show what you’d bring to a design job now.
